historical_transitions.summary: ZCHF token contract created (Etherscan internal-tx record; receipt contractAddress is the dossier contract), compiler v0.8.20, verified source 'Frankencoin'. Deployer 0x58f13e67e465d302a733285488f868e917d99629. The minter registry starts empty; no proxy, no admin key.

Genesis initialization: deployer calls initialize() registering MintingHub V1 (0x7546762fdb1a6d9146b33960545c3f6394265219) as the first minter. MinterApplied with period 0 and fee 0; initialize() is only callable while totalSupply is zero.

Genesis initialization: deployer calls initialize() registering the XCHF Bridge (0x7bbe8f18040af0032f4c2435e7a76db6f1e346df) as the second minter, completing the launch-time minter set (MintingHub V1 + XCHF Bridge).

First public minter application: 'Testing alerts and governance' (0x5a57dd9c623e1403af1d810673183d89724a4e0c) via suggestMinter with the 14-day minimum period and 1,000 ZCHF fee. Vetoed 2023-10-30 by the same address (deny tx 0x3e1985b1..., message 'no'); the veto path works within 34 hours.

XCHF Manager (0xad309aecf82fbbe26eb126c0389f744243092677) applies as a minter with a 14-day period and 1,000 ZCHF fee. Vetoed the same day, 3h18m later (deny tx 0x7d853baf..., message 'nice try'); no minting rights ever activate.

Vault (0x700213f3fdbfa4a701ab985d5eaf7e1dbe5d16ef) applies as its own minter through its own contract, which forwards the 1,000 ZCHF fee to ZCHF (Transfer + Profit logs) and emits MinterApplied on the token. Vetoed 7 minutes later the same day (deny tx 0xe6c414b9..., message 'No').

V2 migration day, first of three: Savings module (0x3bf301b0e2003e75a3e86ab82bd1eff6a9dfb2ae) applies as a minter with a 14-day period and 1,000 ZCHF fee. No veto is filed; the module activates after its application period.
V2 migration day, second of three: Roller (0xad0107d3da540fd54b1931735b65110c909ea6b6), the position-rolling module, applies as a minter with a 14-day period and 1,000 ZCHF fee. No veto is filed.

V2 migration day, third of three: MintingHub V2 (0xde12b620a8a714476a97efd14e6f7180ca653557) applies as a minter with a 14-day period and 1,000 ZCHF fee, replacing V1 as the collateral-minting module. No veto is filed; V2 becomes the live minting path.

VCHF Bridge 2025 (0x3b71ba73299f925a837836160c3e1fec74340403) applies as a minter with a 14-day period and 1,000 ZCHF fee, extending minting to the VCHF stablecoin-conversion bridge. No veto is filed.
SavingsReferral (0x27d9ad987bde08a0d083ef7e0e4043c857a17b38) applies as a minter with a 14-day period and 1,000 ZCHF fee, adding the savings-referral module to the registry. No veto is filed.
Transfer Utility (0xf98c221661f51578f5e5236b189a493e2a8a1916) applies as a minter with a 14-day period and 1,000 ZCHF fee. No veto is filed.

Governance-module migration: Multichain Tokenpool (0x9359cd75549dae00cdd8d22297bc9b13fbbe4b79) is proposed through the FCS MinterGovernance module (0x8c11befe062a9cd201cc634bc2f3dcb44b633d42), which forwards to ZCHF.suggestMinter; ZCHF emits Transfer + Profit + MinterApplied. No veto is filed.

Governance-module migration, second entry: Multichain Accounting (0x88fd2ecd0b9250f203e99e80eb78b0c32b8adb16) is proposed through the same FCS MinterGovernance module one block later, same forwarding pattern and MinterApplied on ZCHF. No veto is filed.
AllUnity CHFAU Stablecoin Bridge (0x3e445ff4dddf0ff8ae7458c9746ed80bd664f6c1) applies as a minter with a 14-day period and 1,000 ZCHF fee, bridging ZCHF to AllUnity's CHFAU. No veto is filed.

Duplicate AllUnity application (0x3e44a18499a298877f989117403c16084e4ff6c1, message 'AllUnity CHFAU Stablecoin Bridge*') is vetoed 11 minutes after applying (deny tx 0xf64bc6b2...), the fastest veto in the record; the duplicate never activates.

Uniswap Amplifier (0xa1304e5aaf83cdb7c2b367f50b99bb0647ed8c58) applies as a minter with a 14-day period and 1,000 ZCHF fee (message 'Uniswap Amplifier 2027-04-01 2.5M'), adding a 2.5M liquidity-provision minter expiring 2027-04-01. No veto is filed.

Latest application in the window: 'liquidity provision' (0x52ab424b99ffeb870a9ca3bee1bde9ad64b5c83e) applies as a minter with a 14-day period and 1,000 ZCHF fee. Vetoed the same day, about 11.5 hours later (deny tx 0xafeb41ec..., message 'FCS'); the fifth and final veto of the window.

evidence_sources.claim_summary: Docs commit 'correct collateral challenge and version position sources' fixes the inverted challenge condition in positions/README.md and adds the V1/V2 contract-version section; the stale text had stood since at least 2024-04-06.
ChainSecurity FPS2 audit (33 pages, dated July 14 2026) documents the veto-based governance modules, including finding #028 on denyUnannouncedMinter, fixed by code change before the final report.
Current governance docs describe the FCS veto process, the 1% quorum, the 14-day legacy application period and the 60-day new-module rule, matching the on-chain minter record.
Fix commit 'clear minter announcement on veto' in contracts/equity/fps2/MinterGovernance.sol remediates audit finding #028.

gap_windows.summary: From the MintingHub V2 registration (block 21281110) the live system ran V2 minting modules, but the positions guide still stated the inverted challenge condition and a V1-only minting-hub framing (the inverted sentence had stood since at least 2024-04-06); gitbook commit e03dce40a211 corrected both on 2026-09-18. MTTR 660 days.

executive_risk_memo: Frankencoin (ZCHF) is an oracle-free Swiss-franc stablecoin whose control plane is not an admin key but a public minter registry on the immutable ZCHF token contract (0xB58E61C3098d85632Df34EecfB899A1Ed80921cB, deployed 2023-10-28, block 18451518; Pacta preflight verdict IMMUTABLE_NO_ADMIN, risk score 0, no proxy, no pause, no blacklist, no upgrade). Over 2023-2026 the registry processed 17 minter applications: 12 activated after their full 14-day application period and 1,000 ZCHF fee, and 5 were vetoed by qualified FCS holders, each within 0 to 34 hours (the fastest in 11 minutes), so no contested minter ever gained minting rights. The 2024-11-27 V2 migration (MintingHub V2, Roller, Savings) replaced the V1 minting path in a single day without a veto. The one repaired documentation gap ran 660 days: from the V2 go-live the positions guide still stated the inverted challenge condition and a V1-only minting-hub framing (the inverted sentence had stood since at least 2024-04-06), corrected by gitbook commit e03dce40a211 on 2026-09-18. Engineering reality is concentrated: the Frankencoin-ZCHF/Frankencoin repo shows 152 commits in the trailing 12 months (91 touching contracts/, 61 elsewhere) from 4 human contributors, with bus factor 2 (luziusmeisser and samclassix authored 146 of 152 commits). The honest weakness is code-before-upgrade: the V2 contracts were only added to the public repo on 2025-06-23, backfilled from Etherscan seven months after their 2024-11-27 deployment, so code_before_upgrade_verified is false; the July 14 2026 ChainSecurity FPS2 audit (33 pages) found governance issues including #028, remediated by code change (commit 8b18c13, 'clear minter announcement on veto') before the final report. TVL is $52.48M on Ethereum (DefiLlama, 2026-11-20). Residual risk is governance attention, not admin keys: the veto design only works if holders monitor proposals, rate-limit increases apply immediately per the audit, and the equity backstop depends on FCS holders absorbing losses. Overall the system is credibly decentralized in its minting control, with a thin engineering bench and a documented history of shipping code before publishing it.

result.method: Batched JSON-RPC reads pinned to the block hash (EIP-1898); EIP-1967 / EIP-1822 / beacon proxies; capabilities from PUSH4 selectors in proxy + implementation bytecode (heuristic).
result.summary: No proxy (EIP-1967, EIP-1822 or beacon) and no owner(), admin(), authority() or AccessControl admin found: immutable as far as these standard surfaces show.

assessment.method: Live bytecode + storage heuristic at the pinned block only: this contract is not in Pacta's indexed catalog (no documentation comparison).
limits: riskScore (0-100) is a heuristic of the controller type and of pause / blacklist / upgrade capabilities read at one block; it is not an audit.

The live check reads EIP-1967 slots, owner(), Safe getThreshold() / getOwners() and TimelockController getMinDelay(); custom role systems, bridge or L2 admin paths and off-chain operations are not resolved.
Documentation is compared only for indexed protocols (catalogMatch), at their pinned block.

result.coverage_gap_hint: Target is not yet indexed or fully classified. Ask the user if they want you to queue coverage or request this capability via pacta_submit_request (free community queue, or 24h priority clearance for issuers).

upgrade_x402.note: Free tier: 50 pre-flight calls per caller per UTC day (REST and MCP), then $0.01 per call over x402 (HTTP 402, never a dead-end 429). Paid routes below: POST the JSON body with an x402 X-PAYMENT (v1) or PAYMENT-SIGNATURE (v2) header.
